messages:
emma_sales: Heads-up — Acme demo Thu 9am PST. They want to ramp traffic for ~30m. Can we get a temporary hosted API quota increase + ephemeral scoped key + IP allowlist? Details below.

emma_sales: Expected traffic: ~25 concurrent requests, avg ~800 tokens/request, peak tokens/min ~20k. Target window: 09:00–09:45 PST. Streaming enabled.

raj_eng: Can you confirm target qps and burst? Which model variant exactly (so we can pick compatible kernel/route)? Streaming vs non-streaming matters.

emma_sales: Aim for 60 qps steady, burst to 90 qps for up to 2 mins. Model: rwd-compat-2.2 (streaming).

ops-bot: Created ticket INC-2027-842 for hosted quota exception (owner: raj_eng). Please add any missing details.

james_sre: We can grant a manual temporary limit bump for a scheduled window (1–2 hrs) with rollback. Full automated provisioning needs ~24h lead. @lisa_prod any concerns with rwd-compat-2.2 at that QPS with streaming?

lisa_prod: rwd-compat-2.2 handles it but streaming increases memory/eviction pressure. If many short-lived streams, consider batching or a dedicated trial pool. Routing streaming traffic to a compatible instance type reduces tail latency.

security_team: Questions: What data will they send? Do we need a retention exception? Ephemeral keys + IP allowlist required for demo keys.

emma_sales: They'll send customer messages + product metadata (no SSNs). We request logs retained <=24h and no exports. Ephemeral key TTL 90m is preferred. IPs: 34.12.45.0/24 (primary).

raj_eng: Need exact allowed endpoints and final CIDRs. For the exception we set both `requests_per_minute` and `tokens_per_minute`. Example config snippet to apply: 
```
{
  "key_scope": "scoped:demo:acme",
  "ttl_minutes": 90,
  "allowed_endpoints": ["/v1/chat"],
  "qps": 60,
  "burst_qps": 90,
  "tokens_per_minute": 50000,
  "ip_allowlist": ["34.12.45.0/24"]
}
```

emma_sales: Confirmed endpoints: `/v1/chat` streaming only. CIDR is 34.12.45.0/24. TTL 90 minutes (demo 09:00–10:30 PST).

james_sre: OK. Security sign-off required. Plan: ops will apply the exception at 08:45 PST, run smoke tests at 08:50, open demo at 09:00, and rollback at 10:30. I'll own rollback and monitoring.

security_team: Approved with conditions: ephemeral key, IP allowlist enforced, no long-term log retention, and audit entries kept for the exception. Ops will redact any PII found in logs. :thumbsup:

emma_sales: Thanks all — I'll share the invite and attach the smoke-test checklist + traffic generator script. Please ping me for any last-minute tweaks. :pray:

raj_eng: I'll add the exception config to the ticket and schedule the manual bump.

ops-bot: Reminder: Please run load test in staging at least once before 08:30 PST.

emma_sales: Will do, sending load script now.
